a: Root → TLD → authoritative name servers resolve names.
A maps to IPv4; AAAA maps to IPv6.
CNAME aliases one name to another.
MX records point to mail servers.
TXT holds arbitrary text (SPF, verification, etc.).
NS records delegate a zone to name servers.
Resolvers cache answers for the TTL duration.
DNSSEC signs DNS data to prevent spoofing.
Multiple A records or geo-DNS distribute traffic.
Changes appear gradually as TTLs expire worldwide.
